t: A pocket LoRa messenger with a keyboard, touchscreen, GPS and battery.
steps: Buy the T-Deck Plus from the LilyGO store or Rokland. Pick the radio band for your country.
Choose the pre-flashed Meshtastic version for the easiest start.
Attach the LoRa antenna before you switch it on.
Charge it with a USB-C cable.
Switch it on and set your name and region with the keyboard.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE and follow the LilyGO T-Deck repo quick start.
Try the LilyGoLib factory example first and check the Arduino-ESP32 version the repo asks for.
meta: Open Board. From $75.49. A few stores.
